requirements.icon_url: Required. Every online plugin must point to a public icon image.
requirements.repository_url: Required. Every online plugin must be hosted in a public GitHub repository.
requirements.tags: Required for catalog publication only. Use one language first, followed by one to three types. Unsupported and extra tags are ignored.
requirements.policy_acceptance: Required. Publication requests must accept the current Plugin Hub catalog rules.
requirements.security_review: Required. Every file and browser-code line must pass static review and a complete ClamAV scan.
requirements.immutable_ref: Required. Published repository_ref values are pinned to the exact reviewed commit.

moderation.broken: Visible as Offline after repeated technical failures.
moderation.hidden: Temporarily unavailable during a credible review.
moderation.removed: Unavailable after an authorized request, confirmed violation, or repeated repository absence.
